strings.ui.memories.film_sub.LS_FB_Settlement: Real history · after the decree of 26 November 1948
strings.fb.nuremberg.line1: For the first time, simultaneous interpreting on a large scale: English, French, Russian and German.
strings.fb.nuremberg.line2: A yellow lamp asked speakers to slow down, a red one to pause.
strings.fb.evictions.line1: According to the office chronicle, an action to clear some 5,000 Jewish flats began.
strings.fb.evictions.line2: From October 1941 many of those driven out were deported.
strings.fb.settlement.place: A special settlement, after the decree of 26 November 1948
strings.fb.settlement.line1: Obliged to report to the commandant’s office, forbidden to leave the district.
strings.fb.settlement.line2: The decree declared the exile permanent; escape carried 20 years of forced labour.
strings.fb.kyshtym.place: Mayak plutonium plant near Chelyabinsk-40, 29 September 1957
strings.fb.kyshtym.line1: After a tank of highly radioactive waste exploded, around 10,000 people were resettled.
strings.fb.kyshtym.line2: The Soviet authorities kept the accident secret.
